branches.en: A smell in the room belongs to nothing known.
branches.cn: 房间里的气味说不出是什么。

branches.en: Courage in a storm stands far above the usual.
branches.cn: 风暴中的勇气远超寻常。

branches.en: What is strange may also be remarkable.
branches.cn: 奇特之物也可能非凡。

branches.en: One form and one great act both stand alone.
branches.cn: 一个词形与一个伟大举动都独自站立。

intro.en: Singular builds words for uniqueness and oddity.
intro.cn: singular 构成表示独特与奇特的词。

latinIntro.en: Singular goes back to Latin singularis.
latinIntro.cn: singular 可追溯至拉丁语 singularis。

items.example: The list gives plurals and singulars.
items.exampleCN: 这张表列出了复数和单数形式。

items.example: The singularity of her style stands out.
items.exampleCN: 她风格的独特十分突出。

items.example: A singular noun takes a singular verb.
The word appears in the singular.
items.exampleCN: 这个词以单数形式出现。
他们表现出非凡的勇气。

definition_zh: 下降；传下来；突然降临
definition_en: to move from a higher place to a lower one, or to come down through time
core_image: 石阶一级级往下，尽头没入山谷里的白雾
scene: 山路上天色转暗，石阶湿滑，大家扶着栏杆一步步往下走。 The path descends steeply toward the river.
sceneCN: 这里 descend 指「下降」（第 1 个义项：从高处往低处走）；句意是小路陡峭地向河边下降。

senses.title: Move to a lower place
senses.definition: to go down from a higher place to a lower one
senses.definitionCN: 从较高的地方走到较低的地方
senses.example: The plane began to descend through the clouds.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机开始穿过云层下降。
senses.why: Gravity offers the easy direction; the body only has to allow it.
senses.whyCN: 重力早已备好省力的方向，身体只需允许它发生。

senses.title: Be passed down
senses.definition: to be handed down from an earlier time or from earlier people
senses.definitionCN: 从更早的年代或更早的人那里传下来
senses.example: The custom has descended from medieval times.
senses.exampleCN: 这一习俗从中世纪传下来。
senses.why: What comes down a family line arrives the way water comes down a hill.
senses.whyCN: 沿血脉传下来的东西，抵达的方式就像水往山下流。

senses.title: Arrive suddenly in numbers
senses.definition: to arrive suddenly and in large numbers, often in a troubling way
senses.definitionCN: 大批地突然到来，常带有令人不安的意味
senses.example: Reporters descended on the small village overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 记者一夜之间涌进这个小村庄。
senses.why: A crowd can fall on a place the way weather falls on it.
senses.whyCN: 人群扑向一个地方，就像天气压下来一样。

intro.en: Descend goes back to Latin descendere, built from de-, down, and scandere, to climb, and it crossed through Old French into English.
intro.cn: descend 可追到拉丁语 descendere，由 de-（向下）与 scandere（攀爬）构成，经古法语进入英语。

items.en: Scandere meant to climb, so descendere meant to climb down.
items.cn: scandere 指攀爬，因此 descendere 指往下爬。

items.en: The image was always bodily: a foot finding a lower step.
items.cn: 这个意象一直是身体性的：一只脚找到更低的一级台阶。

items.en: Descendre kept both the downward motion and the sense of lineage.
items.cn: descendre 同时保留了向下移动与血统这两层意思。

items.en: English used it for stairs, rivers and family lines alike.
items.cn: 英语把它同样用于台阶、河流与家族世系。

items.en: It now also describes crowds and troubles that arrive all at once.
items.cn: 如今它也形容一下子涌来的大批人与麻烦。

note.en: The look-alike group all carry the -scend or -scent shape, and the meaning group all describe a downward movement.
note.cn: 形近组都带着 -scend 或 -scent 的形状，近义组则都表示向下移动。

entries.definition: the act of going down, or a family line
a person who comes from an earlier family
to behave as if you are above others
entries.definitionCN: 表现得好像高别人一等

entries.definition: to move downward without control
to move quickly to a lower position
to go down slowly below a surface
entries.definitionCN: 缓慢沉到某个表面以下

normalIntro.en: These hooks start on a wet stone stair and end with a crowd pouring into a quiet street.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一级湿滑的石阶开始，落到涌进安静街道的人群。

normal.en: Every stair is a small promise that the ground will rise to meet you.
normal.cn: 每一级台阶都在悄悄保证：地面会升上来接住你。

normal.en: The same word carries a body down and a family name forward.
normal.cn: 同一个词，既把身体送下去，也把姓氏传下去。

normal.en: A crowd descends the way rain does: all at once, from above.
normal.cn: 人群的到来像雨：从上方一下子落下来。

normal.en: Climb up and you ascend; climb down and you descend.
normal.cn: 往上爬是 ascend，往下爬就是 descend。

normal.en: A descendant is simply someone who came down the family stairs.
normal.cn: 后裔不过是从家族那道楼梯走下来的人。

abstract.en: Picture a hand sliding along a cold stone rail.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手沿着冰冷的石栏滑下去。

abstract.en: Picture a valley filling with mist as the path goes lower.
abstract.cn: 想象路越走越低，雾气渐渐填满山谷。

abstract.en: Picture thirty reporters standing at one narrow door.
abstract.cn: 想象三十名记者挤在一扇窄门前。

examples.en: The plane began to descend through the clouds.
examples.cn: 飞机开始穿过云层下降。

examples.en: The custom has descended from medieval times.
examples.cn: 这一习俗从中世纪传下来。

examples.en: Reporters descended on the small village overnight.
examples.cn: 记者一夜之间涌进这个小村庄。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 descend 记成「地森得」：de 是向下，scend 像「升」，反过来走，就是往下。

root: 来自拉丁语 descendere，由 de-（向下）与 scandere（攀爬）组成，经古法语 descendre 进入英语。本义是沿台阶往下走，后来用于血统的传承，也形容人或麻烦大批突然到来。

sensesIntro.en: From a foot taking a lower step, to a family line handed down, to a crowd falling on a place.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一只脚踩向更低一级台阶，到一条传下来的血脉，再到扑向某处的人群。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a foot finding the next step down.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只脚去找下一级向下的台阶。

chain: A FOOT FINDS A LOWER STEP
A PATH SLOPES TO THE VALLEY
A CROWD FALLS ON A PLACE

branches.en: The first sense is plain downward motion.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是单纯的向下移动。

branches.en: The second sense sends the same motion through time instead of space.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把同一种移动从空间移到了时间上。

branches.en: The third sense is motion that arrives all at once, like weather.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是一下子到来的移动，像天气那样。

branches.en: Stairs and generations share one picture: each step passes something down.
branches.cn: 台阶与世代共用一幅图：每一级都把东西传下去。

branches.en: A plane and a crowd both leave the height they were at.
branches.cn: 飞机与人群都离开了原来所在的高处。

intro.en: Descend builds a family around going down, family lines and the idea of stepping lower.
intro.cn: descend 长出一族词，围绕向下、血统以及「踏低一级」这个动作。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is scandere, to climb, and de- turns the climb downward.
latinIntro.cn: 它的拉丁词基是 scandere（攀爬），前缀 de- 把这次攀爬转向下方。

items.exampleCN: 他们的后代仍住在这里。

items.example: Put the names in descending order.

items.example: He would not condescend to explain.

items.meaning: a part that goes below the line
items.example: The letter g has a descender.
items.exampleCN: 字母 g 有一个下伸部分。

definition_zh: 一把；少量；难对付的人
definition_en: as much as one hand can hold, a small number, or a person who is hard to control
core_image: 一只手抓起的坚果
scene: 他抓了一把坚果。 He took a handful of nuts.
sceneCN: 这里 handful 是「一把」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他抓了一把坚果。

senses.title: One hand's amount
senses.definition: as much of something as one hand can hold
senses.definitionCN: 一只手能握住的量
senses.example: He took a handful of nuts.
senses.exampleCN: 他抓了一把坚果。
senses.why: The amount held in one hand is the base sense.

senses.title: Small number

senses.definitionCN: 少量的人或物

senses.exampleCN: 只有少数人来。
senses.why: A hand's worth became a figure for a small amount.

senses.title: Hard to manage

senses.definitionCN: 难以控制或应付的人或事
senses.example: The little boy is a real handful.
senses.exampleCN: 这个小男孩真难管。
senses.why: Something that fills both hands takes all your effort.
senses.whyCN: 需要双手才能应付的东西，会占去全部力气。

core_image: 墙根下一只拖长尾巴窜过的灰影
scene: 夜里厨房的墙根窸窣作响，一只灰影贴着地面窜过。 A rat ran along the wall and vanished into a hole.
sceneCN: 这里 rat 是「老鼠」（第 1 个义项：一种拖着长尾的小型鼠类）；句意为一只老鼠沿墙跑过，钻进洞里不见了。画面里可留意：墙根的阴影、长长的尾巴、狭小的洞口。

derivatives.zh: rat 加 -y，原指多鼠的，今指破旧的或恼火的
rat 加 -er，指捕鼠的狗或猫
复数用作感叹，表示懊恼

senses.title: The animal
senses.definition: a small furry animal with a long tail, larger than a mouse
senses.definitionCN: 一种拖着长尾的小型毛皮动物，比家鼠大
senses.example: A rat ran along the wall and vanished into a hole.
senses.exampleCN: 一只老鼠沿墙跑过，钻进洞里不见了。
senses.why: The name of the animal is old in English and has stayed almost unchanged in form and meaning.
senses.whyCN: 这种动物的名称在英语中很古老，形与义几乎未变。

senses.title: A despicable person
senses.definition: a contemptible or disloyal person, used as a strong insult
senses.definitionCN: 一个可鄙或不忠的人，用作强烈的侮辱
senses.example: You rat! You told them everything.
senses.exampleCN: 你这个叛徒！你全告诉他们了。
senses.why: Because the rat was seen as dirty and stealing, its name became a ready insult for someone thought to be treacherous.
senses.whyCN: 由于老鼠被视为肮脏而偷食，它的名字便成了骂背信者的现成侮辱。

senses.title: To inform on someone
senses.definition: to give information about someone to those in authority, or to betray a friend
senses.definitionCN: 向当权者提供某人的情况，或背叛朋友
senses.example: He felt he had been ratted on by his own team.
senses.exampleCN: 他觉得自己被自己的团队出卖了。
senses.why: The verb came from the insult: to rat is to behave like the animal, sneaking and giving others away.
senses.whyCN: 动词来自那层侮辱：to rat 就是像这种动物一样偷偷摸摸、把别人交出去。

intro.en: Rat is an old English word, ræt, matching Old French rat; the deeper origin is uncertain and no reliable Latin source can be named.
intro.cn: rat 是古老的英语词 ræt，与古法语 rat 相合；更早的来源不确定，也举不出可靠的拉丁语来源。

items.en: Old English had ræt for the animal, a word already well established.
items.cn: 古英语已有指这种动物的 ræt，是一个相当稳固的词。

items.en: The same animal name appears in Old French as rat, and the two forms likely reinforced each other.
items.cn: 同样的动物名称在古法语中作 rat，两种形式很可能相互加强。

items.en: The deeper origin is uncertain: no clear Latin or Germanic source can be named with confidence.
items.cn: 更早的来源不确定：无法有把握地指出清晰的拉丁语或日耳曼语来源。

items.en: English extended the animal name to a disloyal person, and later made a verb meaning to inform on someone.
items.cn: 英语把这一动物名引申指不忠之人，后来又造出意为「告发他人」的动词。

items.en: Modern English keeps rat for the animal, for a contemptible person, and for the act of betraying.
items.cn: 现代英语仍用 rat 指这种动物、可鄙之人，以及背叛的行为。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers close forms and two words often confused with rat; the near-meaning group gathers animal and informer words.
note.cn: 形近组收近形词与两个常与 rat 混淆的词；近义组收动物词与告密者词。

entries.definition: A measure or a speed, a different word.
entries.definitionCN: 一种比率或速度，另一词。

entries.definition: To some degree, a different word.
Shabby or irritated, from rat.
entries.definitionCN: 破旧的或恼火的，源自 rat。

entries.definition: A dog or cat that catches rats.
A small rodent with a thin tail.
A mammal with sharp front teeth for gnawing.
entries.definitionCN: 长有门齿、善于啃咬的哺乳动物。

entries.definition: A person who gives information about others.
A person who betrays a friend or a country.

normalIntro.en: The animal name turned into an insult and then into a verb, so one word now carries a creature, a judgment and an act of betrayal.
normalIntro.cn: 动物名先变成侮辱，再变成动词，于是一个词同时承载一种生物、一种评判与一种背叛行为。

normal.en: Rat and rate look alike, but a rat is an animal and a rate is a measure.
normal.cn: rat 与 rate 形近，但 rat 是动物，rate 是度量。

normal.en: To rat on a friend is to act like the animal people despise.
normal.cn: rat on a friend 就是像人们厌恶的那种动物一样行事。

normal.en: A ratter is a dog kept to catch rats.
normal.cn: ratter 是养来捕鼠的狗。

normal.en: Ratty once meant full of rats, then shabby, then bad-tempered.
normal.cn: ratty 曾指多鼠的，后指破旧的，再指脾气坏的。

normal.en: The long tail is the quickest way to tell a rat from a mouse.
normal.cn: 长尾巴是分辨 rat 与 mouse 最快的办法。

abstract.en: Calling a person a rat is a judgment, not a description.
abstract.cn: 把人称作 rat，是一种评判，而不是描述。

abstract.en: The animal became an insult because it is seen as dirty and stealing.
abstract.cn: 这种动物成了侮辱，因为它被视为肮脏又偷食。

abstract.en: To rat is to leave your own side for another.
abstract.cn: to rat 就是离开自己一方，投向另一方。

examples.en: A rat ran along the wall and vanished into a hole.
examples.cn: 一只老鼠沿墙跑过，钻进洞里不见了。

examples.en: He felt he had been ratted on by his own team.
examples.cn: 他觉得自己被自己的团队出卖了。

examples.en: You rat! You told them everything.
examples.cn: 你这个叛徒！你全告诉他们了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「拉特」——墙根窜过的小黑影，记住 rat 是老鼠，也指叛徒。

root: 古英语 ræt（鼠），与古法语 rat 同形，可能相互强化；更早来源不确定，没有可考的拉丁语词根。同族有 ratty、ratter。

sensesIntro.en: The core is the animal; the senses extend to the insult drawn from its reputation and to the act of betraying.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是这种动物；义项延伸到由其名声而来的侮辱，以及背叛的行为。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a grey shape slipping along the wall with a long tail trailing behind.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个灰色影子沿着墙根溜过，长尾巴拖在后头。

branches.en: a grey shape slipping along a wall
branches.cn: 沿墙溜过的灰色影子

branches.en: a name spat at a traitor
branches.cn: 朝叛徒啐出的称呼

branches.en: a whisper to the authorities
branches.cn: 向当局的一阵耳语

branches.en: the animal and the insult
branches.cn: 动物与侮辱

branches.en: a disloyal person and the act of betraying
branches.cn: 不忠之人与出卖之举

intro.en: The word is short and native, and its small family is built with English endings and compounds.
intro.cn: 这个词短小且为本族词，其不大的词族由英语词尾与复合词构成。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin source is recorded; the word's deeper origin is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 没有可靠的拉丁语来源记录；这个词更早的来源不确定。

definition_zh: 压缩；简缩；使浓缩；凝结
definition_en: to make something shorter or denser, or to change from gas to liquid
core_image: 炉上的一锅汤慢慢收干，只剩浓浓的精华
scene: 厨师把汤再熬一会儿，让味道更集中。 Simmer the sauce to condense its flavour.
sceneCN: 这里 condense 指「使浓缩」（第 2 个义项：让液体变得更浓）；句意是把酱汁再熬一会儿，让味道更浓。

senses.title: Make writing shorter
senses.definition: to reduce a speech or piece of writing to fewer words
senses.definitionCN: 把讲话或文章减少到更少的字数
senses.example: She condensed the report into two pages.
senses.exampleCN: 她把报告压缩成了两页。
senses.why: A shorter text keeps only what cannot be removed.
senses.whyCN: 更短的文字只留下删不掉的部分。

senses.title: Make a liquid denser
senses.definition: to make a liquid thicker by removing water
senses.definitionCN: 通过去掉水分使液体变浓
senses.example: Boil the soup to condense the flavour.
senses.exampleCN: 把汤煮一煮，让味道更浓。
senses.why: Less water means more taste in every spoon.
senses.whyCN: 水少了，每一勺里的味道就更多。

senses.title: Turn gas into drops
senses.definition: to change from a gas into a liquid
senses.definitionCN: 由气体变成液体
senses.example: Steam condensed on the cold window.
senses.exampleCN: 蒸汽在冰冷的窗上凝结。
senses.why: Cool air pulls the wandering vapour back into drops.
senses.whyCN: 冷空气把游走的水汽拉回成水珠。

intro.en: Condense comes from Latin condensare, to make dense, built from com-, together, and densus, thick.
intro.cn: condense 来自拉丁语 condensare，意为使浓密，由 com-（一起）与 densus（浓密）构成。

items.en: Densus described air or matter packed closely together.
items.cn: densus 描述空气或物质紧密挤在一起。

items.en: Condensare meant to press something into a smaller space.
items.cn: condensare 意为把东西压进更小的空间。

items.en: French condenser applied the idea to both text and vapour.
items.cn: 法语 condenser 把这个意思同时用于文字与水汽。

items.en: English condense first described liquids thickened by heat.
items.cn: 英语 condense 最初描述用加热变浓的液体。

items.en: It now also means to shorten a text without losing its main point.
items.cn: 如今它也指在不丢失要点的前提下缩短文字。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that begin like condense, and the meaning group names other ways of making something smaller or thicker.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 condense 词形相近的词，近义组列出其他让东西变小或变浓的说法。

entries.definition: to say strongly that something is wrong
to accept wrong behaviour without blame
to help to produce a result
to press something into less space
to make something less long
to make a liquid stronger by removing water

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a pot on a stove, then move to a shortened page and to drops on cold glass.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从炉上的锅开始，再走到被缩短的页面与冷玻璃上的水珠。

normal.en: Con- is together and dense means thick, so condense is to press things together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，dense 是浓密，所以 condense 就是把东西挤到一起。

normal.en: A long report condensed is a short report that still works.
normal.cn: 被压缩的长报告，是一份仍然管用的短报告。

normal.en: Condensed milk is milk that has lost most of its water.
normal.cn: 炼乳就是去掉了大部分水分的牛奶。

normal.en: Steam condenses the moment it meets something cold.
normal.cn: 蒸汽一碰到冷的东西就凝结。

normal.en: Condense the message until only the point is left.
normal.cn: 把信息压缩到只剩要点为止。

abstract.en: Picture a wide cloud squeezed into a single drop.
abstract.cn: 想象一片大云被挤成一颗水珠。

abstract.en: Picture a thick book folded into a thin card.
abstract.cn: 想象一本厚书被折成一张薄卡片。

abstract.en: Picture soup bubbling down to a dark rich paste.
abstract.cn: 想象汤汁收成一小团深色浓浆。

examples.en: The editor condensed the article to one page.
examples.cn: 编辑把文章压缩到了一页。

examples.en: Water vapour condenses into drops on the glass.
examples.cn: 水蒸气在玻璃上凝结成水珠。

examples.en: Add less water if you want to condense the sauce.
examples.cn: 若想让酱汁更浓，就少加点水。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 condense 记成 con（一起）加 dense（浓密）：把东西挤到一起、把水去掉，就是压缩与浓缩；水汽挤成水珠就是凝结。

root: 源自拉丁语 condensare（com 一起 + densus 浓密），本义是挤密，后引申为压缩文字、浓缩液体与凝结。

sensesIntro.en: From a thickened liquid, to a shortened text, and finally to vapour turning into water.
sensesIntro.cn: 从变浓的液体，到被缩短的文字，最后到水汽变成水。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wide cloud pressed into one heavy drop.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片宽大的云被压成一颗沉甸甸的水珠。

branches.en: Text is condensed by removing what can be spared.
branches.cn: 文字靠删去可有可无的部分来压缩。

branches.en: A liquid is condensed by driving off its water.
branches.cn: 液体靠赶走水分来浓缩。

branches.en: Cooling makes vapour gather back into drops.
branches.cn: 降温让水汽重新聚成水珠。

branches.en: Both senses leave more value in a smaller space.
branches.cn: 两个义项都让更小的空间里装下更多内容。

branches.en: Thickening and dripping are two ends of the same process.
branches.cn: 变浓与滴落是同一过程的两端。

intro.en: Condense is built on Latin com-, together, plus densus, thick or dense.
intro.cn: condense 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 densus（浓密）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base dens- also appears in dense and density.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 dens- 也出现在 dense 与 density 中。

items.example: Condense the paragraph if you can.
items.exampleCN: 如果可以就把这段压缩一下。

items.example: Cold air condenses the vapour quickly.
items.exampleCN: 冷空气让水汽很快凝结。

items.example: They condensed the speech to ten minutes.
items.exampleCN: 他们把演讲压缩到十分钟。

items.meaning: the change from gas to liquid
items.exampleCN: 凝结的水汽蒙住了窗户。

items.meaning: a device that turns gas into liquid

items.example: She added condensed milk to the coffee.
The forest is dense and dark.

definition_zh: 羽毛；翎毛；用羽毛装饰
definition_en: one of the light growths covering a bird, plumage used as material, or to cover or line something with feathers
core_image: 一阵风吹过，一根细软的绒羽打着旋落在窗台上
scene: 一阵风把鸟的绒羽吹到窗台上。 A soft feather drifted onto the windowsill.
sceneCN: 这里 feather 是「羽毛」（第 1 个义项）；句意：一根柔软的羽毛飘到窗台上。

pos.zh: 用羽毛装饰；使桨叶平转

senses.title: A bird's covering
senses.definition: one of the light growths that cover a bird's body
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖鸟身的一种轻盈生长物
senses.example: A feather floated down from the nest.
senses.exampleCN: 一根羽毛从鸟巢里飘落下来。
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的实物义。

senses.title: Plumage as material
senses.definition: feathers used together as material or decoration
senses.definitionCN: 作为材料或装饰集中使用的羽毛
senses.example: The arrow was trimmed with feathers.
senses.exampleCN: 这支箭用羽毛做尾翼。
senses.why: Many feathers together become a material.
senses.whyCN: 许多羽毛聚在一起便成为材料。

senses.title: To turn an oar flat
senses.definition: to turn an oar blade flat as it moves through the air
senses.definitionCN: 划桨时把桨叶转平以减少阻力
senses.example: She feathered the oars and let the boat glide.
senses.exampleCN: 她把桨叶转平，让船滑行。
senses.why: The verb compares the oar blade to a feather.
senses.whyCN: 动词把桨叶比作羽毛。

intro.en: Feather goes back to Old English feþer and a Germanic root for wing or feather.
intro.cn: feather 可追溯到古英语 feþer，出自表示翅膀或羽毛的日耳曼语词根。

items.en: The root named a feather or wing.
items.cn: 该词根表示羽毛或翅膀。

items.en: Feþer meant a feather or plumage.
items.cn: feþer 意为羽毛或羽饰。

items.en: The spelling became fether.
items.cn: 拼写变为 fether。

items.en: Feather settled into its modern spelling.
items.cn: feather 固定为现代拼写。

items.en: The word also became a verb for feathering oars.
items.cn: 现代英语中该词又成为表示「转平桨叶」的动词。

note.en: Feather is compared with similar-looking words and with words for bird coverings.
note.cn: 把 feather 与形近词以及表示鸟类覆盖物的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Feather is a bird's light covering, the material made from many, and a verb for oars.
normalIntro.cn: feather 是鸟的轻羽、许多羽毛构成的材料，也可作动词表示转平桨叶。

normal.en: Birds of a feather flock together.
normal.cn: 物以类聚，人以群分。

normal.en: Light as a feather means extremely light.
normal.cn: light as a feather 意为轻如鸿毛。

normal.en: A feather in your cap is an achievement to be proud of.
normal.cn: a feather in your cap 指值得骄傲的成就。

normal.en: Feather and father differ in one vowel sound.
normal.cn: feather 与 father 只差一个元音。

normal.en: To ruffle feathers is to upset people.
normal.cn: ruffle feathers 意为惹人不快。

abstract.en: A feather is light, yet it keeps a bird warm and dry.
abstract.cn: 羽毛很轻，却能为鸟保暖防湿。

abstract.en: Feathers once served as pens, turning flight into writing.
abstract.cn: 羽毛曾用作笔，把飞行变成了书写。

abstract.en: The smallest covering can carry the whole bird.
abstract.cn: 最轻的覆盖物也能承载整只鸟。

examples.en: A feather floated down from the nest.
examples.cn: 一根羽毛从鸟巢里飘落下来。

examples.en: The arrow was trimmed with feathers.

examples.en: She feathered the oars and let the boat glide.

sensesIntro.cn: feather 意为鸟的羽毛、用作材料的翎毛，或使桨叶平转。

core.en: A light covering that lets a bird fly and stay warm.
core.cn: 让鸟飞行并保暖的轻盈覆盖物。

branches.en: One light growth on a bird.
branches.cn: 鸟身上的一根轻羽。

branches.en: Many feathers used as material.
branches.cn: 作为材料使用的许多羽毛。

branches.en: The act of turning an oar flat.
branches.cn: 把桨叶转平的动作。

branches.en: A single feather and a mass of plumage belong together.
branches.cn: 单根羽毛与整身羽饰密不可分。

branches.en: The oar blade is compared to a feather in motion.
branches.cn: 划动的桨叶被比作运动中的羽毛。

intro.en: Feather forms words for lightness, covering, and a few old compounds.
intro.cn: feather 构成表示轻盈、覆盖以及若干古老复合词的词。

The nest was lined with feathers.

items.example: The featherbrain forgot his keys again.
items.exampleCN: 那个粗心的人又把钥匙忘了。
